parent.r49_original_dev: synthetic R49 DEV pass 2/2 at zero regret, 8448/8448 action parity on both OS, Native ablation 0; not independent scientific PASS

hypothesis.main: The R49 three-parameter learned context reader relies on a hand-coded top-two HIGH public-tag retrieval rule and should NOT be declared event discovery without surviving held-out public tag confounding where the two highest public tags mark causally irrelevant but genuinely selected low-magnitude outcomes.
hypothesis.falsifier: Retrain only R49's already frozen FIT procedure and score its frozen weights on NEW matched-gate OOD worlds with high-tag nuisance; compare with a source-observation-only positive reference that ranks genuinely observed physical effect magnitude, never private identities.
hypothesis.outcome_policy: If frozen model misses threshold on either original seed, retain scientific transfer failure; do not update R49's previously qualified original distribution, tune to new panels, or rename source-specific positive control as learned intelligence.
hypothesis.narrower_claim: This tests robustness of R49's HAND-CODED event selection under an explicit adversarial public-key shift, not whether attention learning can ever generalize and not real-world causal intelligence.

confounding_nuisance.placement: SHA256(salt,group) draws 4 DISTINCT positions, first two causal cue/decoy and remaining two confounding high public tags; private position IDs never sent to model

source.observed_record: Exactly R49 public selected _record(observed_tag, selected action t%2, after observed_tag+selected_physical_delta, public_context) with effect[4] zero; 5 original R49 selected early/probe facts and actual return-action public key also present; mask unseen return effect.
source.return_physics: Original R49 quartic FIT and cubic OOD selected return evaluator, actual selected factual action consequence; no generator extra hidden q/gate to learner
source.original_FIT_only_training: Use unchanged, previously frozen R49 FIT streams and original two seed training draws with no new adaptation or training on new R50 OOD source; independently reproduce original R49 trained weights from public original R49 trainer with exact original checkpoints.
source.true_positive_reference: From selected public B history use |decoded physical effect|>.06 (top two); choose higher/lower of these tag states by public context, combine with FIT-only measured fifth, no hidden q/gate/index, require 0/64 error before model score
source.gate_parity: Opposite hidden gates at fixed public context, q sign and group have equal public full 16-channel B mean and action keys, but different selected causal observations.

methods.scoring: No gradients, optimizer steps, fine-tuning, OOD label fitting, or source selection after original FIT reproduction. Score 64 new OOD worlds/arm/seed plus public tag-erasure and B/fifth erasure controls. Cold restore trained weight state and action parity.
baselines: trained raw-context R49 3-param model on identical FIT information/actions/updates
trained Native-augmented R49 same FIT but not parameter matched
trained GRU same original FIT inputs, not compute matched
hand-coded observation-only feasibility positive reference; never claim learned upper bound
capture: per-arm group/context regrets and gate flips

frozen_decision.if_main_fail: Report TRANSFER_NO_GO for out-of-support public-tag confound. Preserve R49 original DEV_PASS unchanged. A failure is evidence of source-specific retrieval bias, not broad failure of all trainable causal memory.
frozen_decision.if_main_pass: Report provisional R50 confound robustness only on this synthetic protocol, inspect per-context/negative controls; never promote or claim Native-specific gain without positive backbone ablation and full capacity/compute parity.
